title: Coupled reciprocal-sum inequalities for Neumann eigenvalues in rank-one symmetric spaces
summary: Let $M$ be a rank-one symmetric space of compact or noncompact type and real dimension $m=kn$, where $k\in\{1,2,4,8\}$ is the real dimension of the underlying division algebra. Meng and Wang proved sharp isoperimetric inequalities for reciprocal sums of the first $p$ or $\ell$ nonzero Neumann eigenvalues, with indices strictly below $m$ in the nonconstant-curvature cases. We keep the whole $m$-dimensional transplanted first eigenspace of an equimeasurable geodesic ball and treat its mass and stiffness forms as a coupled generalized eigenvalue problem.
